text:
PagerDuty Bot: 🚨 PagerDuty alert fired: PD-4721 — runtime-gateway high 5xx rate (policy: infra-critical). Escalation chain: primary -> secondary -> manager. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4721
Incident Bot: incident-bot noticed spike: 5xx rate >= 25% for 3m in us-west-runtime. Auto-page triggered at 2026-11-02T03:47:14Z.
Maya: acked in PD at 03:48, I'll take a look — currently on-call primary.
Zara: hey, I see a surge in queue latency in the metrics dashboard; trace IDs showing KV cache misses. tagging @Liam since he's next for handoff if this goes long.
Incident Bot: Escalation note: secondary (Liam) not reached within 5m -> manager (Jonah) paged at 03:54:20Z.
Liam: sorry I'm on a flight, no mobile for PD. can't ack from here, pls escalate to manager.
Jonah: acked the PD page at 03:55. jumping in. what is customer impact?
Maya: observed error rate ~30% for model-serving requests hitting runtime-gateway in us-west. Some customers seeing 502s and timeouts, others full fallbacks. Broad impact on short-seq generation routes.
Jonah: ok, prioritizing mitigation. quick plan: 1) enable fallback routing to dedicated-backup pool 2) roll restart runtime-gateway pods in us-west 3) temporarily disable aggressive batching.
Zara: putting runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-outages — section "fallback routing".
Jonah: executing failover command now: `kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-gateway FALLBACK_POOL=dedicated-backup --record`
Maya: logs show repeated kernel OOM patterns on node runtime-gw-7: 
```
ERROR OOM killer invoked: process llm-infer (pid 42111) killed
[2026-11-02T03:45:38Z] infer::alloc failed: out of memory
```
Suggest we cordon runtime-gw-7 and drain.
Jonah: cordoning node and draining: `kubectl cordon runtime-gw-7 && kubectl drain runtime-gw-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — starting now.
Incident Bot: PD escalation action: manager acknowledged and manual reroute applied. PagerDuty note added: "manager took ownership — failover applied, draining suspect node".
SRE Team: monitoring rollout: adding temporary rate-limits to reduce thundering herd on warmup.
Liam: thanks for the heads up — I'll follow up for the formal handoff and take on-call in 20m once plane lands. please DM me any followups.
Maya: after failover, 5xx dropped from 30% -> 6% in 4m. still seeing some tail 502s for cached prefixes.
Jonah: good. leaving a sticky checklist here for postmortem: impact window, root cause (OOM + cache thrash), why secondary missed ack (flight), verify PD policy timings, add SMS fallback for secondary, add a manager on-call for this pump.
Zara: creating incident ticket ENG-3912 and capturing timeline. assigning SRE rotation for RCA.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-4721 status: acknowledged by Jonah, responder: on-call SRE, escalation truncated. Close when services stable and RCAs posted.
Maya: ETA for full recovery ~30-45m while nodes drain and caches rebuild. Will update here and mark when resolved. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jonah: thx everyone. if error rate creeps >10% again, we re-open and escalate to infra lead. tagging @SRE Team for follow-up. :eyes:
Incident Bot: Thread closed for now, will ping if any re-escalation events occur.
